sentences.zh: 天福四年春正月癸卯，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year of Tianfu, on the first day guimao of the first month, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations, with guards and regalia as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Tianfu 4, on the first day of the first month (day guimao), the emperor held audience in Chongyuan Hall to receive New Year congratulations, with guards and ceremonial regalia in full form.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召太子太師致仕範延光宴於便殿。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Fan Yanguang, Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was summoned to a banquet in the Privy Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the emperor summoned Fan Yanguang, retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, to a banquet in the Privy Hall.

sentences.zh: 以延光歸命之後，慮懷疑懼，故休假之內，錫以款密。

translations.literal: Because after Yanguang submitted to the dynasty he feared suspicion and dread, during his leave the Emperor bestowed intimate favor upon him.
translations.idiomatic: After Yanguang had surrendered, he still feared suspicion and anxiety; during his leave of absence the emperor therefore treated him with warm, confidential kindness.

sentences.zh: 帝謂之曰：「無忿疾以傷厥神，無憂思以勞厥衷。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to him: "Do not let anger harm your spirit; do not let worry and anxiety weary your heart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him, "Do not let resentment harm your spirit, and do not let worry and brooding weary your heart.

sentences.zh: 朕方示信於四方，豈食言於汝也。

translations.literal: I am now displaying trust to all quarters—how could I break my word to you."
translations.idiomatic: I am now showing good faith to the realm—how could I go back on my word to you."

sentences.zh: 」延光俯伏拜謝，其心遂安。

translations.literal: Yanguang prostrated himself and bowed in thanks; his heart was then at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang prostrated himself and bowed in thanks, and his mind was finally at ease.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以西京副留守龍敏為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Long Min, Deputy Military Commissioner of the Western Capital, was made Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Long Min, deputy military commissioner of the Western Capital, was appointed vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 戊申，盜發唐閔帝陵。

translations.literal: On wushen, grave robbers broke into the tomb of Tang Emperor Min.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, robbers broke into the tomb of Emperor Min of Tang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朔方軍節度使張希崇卒，贈太師。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhang Xichong, military commissioner of Shuofang, died; posthumously awarded Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhang Xichong, military commissioner of Shuofang, died and was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 以澶州防禦使張從恩為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong'en, defense commissioner of Chanzou, was made Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong'en, defense commissioner of Chanzou, was appointed deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以侍衛步軍都指揮使、寧江軍節度使景延廣為義成軍節度使，以義成軍節度使馮暉為朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jing Yanguang, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers and military commissioner of Ningjiang, was made military commissioner of Yicheng; Feng Hui, military commissioner of Yicheng, was made military commissioner of Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jing Yanguang, commander of the palace guard foot soldiers and military commissioner of Ningjiang, was transferred to Yicheng; Feng Hui, military commissioner of Yicheng, was transferred to Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，左諫議大夫曹國珍上言：「請於內外臣僚之中，選才略之士，聚《唐六典》、前後《會要》、《禮閣新儀》、《大中統類》、律令格式等，精詳纂集，俾無漏落，別為書一部，目為《大晉政統》。

translations.literal: On yimao, Left Remonstrance Grandee Cao Guozhen submitted a memorial: "From among civil and military officials at court and abroad, select men of talent and strategy; gather the Tang Six Canons, earlier and later Essentials, New Rites of the Ritual Pavilion, Taizhong Compendia, statutes, ordinances, formats, and the like; compile them with care and precision so that nothing is omitted; compile a separate book and title it Great Jin Administrative Canon."
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Left Remonstrance Grandee Cao Guozhen memorialized: "From among officials inside and outside the court, select men of ability and strategy to gather the Tang Six Canons, the earlier and later Essentials, the New Rites of the Ritual Pavilion, the Taizhong Compendia, statutes, ordinances, and formats, and compile them meticulously so that nothing is left out, producing a separate work to be titled the Great Jin Administrative Canon."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 其詳議官，宜差太子少師梁文矩、左散騎常侍張允、大理卿張澄、國子祭酒唐汭、大理少卿高鴻漸、國子司業田敏、禮部郎中呂咸休、司勛員外郎劉濤、刑部員外郎李知損、監察御史郭延升等一十九人充。

translations.literal: For the detailed deliberation officers, nineteen persons including Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Liang Wenju, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Zhang Yun, Grand Judge of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Cheng, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education Tang Rui, Vice Grand Judge Gao Hongjian, Vice Chancellor of the Directorate Tian Min, Bureau Director of Rites Lü Xianxiu, Outer Office Director of Merits Liu Tao, Outer Office Director of Punishments Li Zhishun, and Investigating Censor Guo Yansheng were to be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the detailed deliberation, nineteen officials were appointed, including Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Liang Wenju, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Zhang Yun, Grand Judge Zhang Cheng, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education Tang Rui, Vice Grand Judge Gao Hongjian, Vice Chancellor Tian Min, Bureau Director of Rites Lü Xianxiu, Outer Office Director of Merits Liu Tao, Outer Office Director of Punishments Li Zhishun, and Investigating Censor Guo Yansheng.

sentences.zh: 文矩等咸曰：「改前代禮樂刑憲為《大晉政統》，則《堯典》、《舜典》當以《晉典》革名。

translations.literal: Wenju and the others all said: "If the rites, music, punishments, and statutes of former dynasties are changed into the Great Jin Administrative Canon, then the Canon of Yao and Canon of Shun ought to have their names changed to the Jin Canon."
translations.idiomatic: Wenju and the others all said, "To recast the rites, music, punishments, and statutes of former dynasties as the Great Jin Administrative Canon would mean that the Canon of Yao and the Canon of Shun would have to be renamed the Jin Canon."

sentences.zh: 」列狀駁之曰：

translations.literal: They submitted a collective memorial refuting it, saying:
translations.idiomatic: They submitted a joint memorial in rebuttal, stating:

sentences.zh: 作者之謂聖，述者之謂明，茍非聖明，焉能述作。

translations.literal: He who creates is called a sage; he who expounds is called enlightened—if one is not sage and enlightened, how can one expound and create.
translations.idiomatic: The creator is called a sage; the expounder is called enlightened—without sage wisdom and enlightenment, how could one compose and compile.

sentences.zh: 若運因革故，則事乃維新，或改正朔而變犧牲，或易服色而殊徽號。

translations.literal: When the age calls for change and renewal, affairs are made new; sometimes the calendar is corrected and sacrifices altered, sometimes dress colors are changed and emblems made distinct.
translations.idiomatic: When the times demand reform, affairs are renewed—sometimes the calendar is corrected and sacrifices changed, sometimes dress colors and insignia are altered.

sentences.zh: 是以五帝殊時，不相沿樂；

translations.literal: Therefore the Five Emperors in different ages did not continue one another's music;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Five Emperors, living in different ages, did not inherit one another's music;

sentences.zh: 三王異世，不相襲禮。

translations.literal: the Three Kings in different generations did not inherit one another's rites.
translations.idiomatic: and the Three Kings, in different generations, did not inherit one another's rites.

sentences.zh: 至於近代，率由舊章；

translations.literal: As for recent times, all generally followed old regulations;
translations.idiomatic: In recent times, however, governments have generally followed established regulations;

sentences.zh: 比及前朝，日滋條目。

translations.literal: by the time of the previous dynasty, entries daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: and by the previous dynasty the number of provisions grew day by day.

sentences.zh: 多因行事之失，改為立制之初，或臣奏條章，君行可否，皆表其年月，紀以姓名，聚類分門，成文作則。

translations.literal: Most arose from errors in administration and were changed at the beginning of establishing institutions; sometimes ministers submitted regulations and the ruler approved or rejected them—all recorded their year and month, noted names, grouped by category and divided by section, formed texts and made standards.
translations.idiomatic: Most arose from administrative failures and were revised when new institutions were established; sometimes ministers submitted regulations and the ruler approved or rejected them—all dated by year and month, attributed by name, classified by category, and set down as written standards.

sentences.zh: 莫不悉稽前典，垂範後昆，述自聖賢，歷於朝代，得金科玉條之號，設亂言破律之防，守而行之，其來尚矣。

translations.literal: None failed to examine fully the former canons, hand down models to later generations, expound from sages and worthies, pass through dynastic ages, obtain the title of golden statutes and jade provisions, and set defenses against reckless words that break the law—preserving and implementing them: this has long been the case.
translations.idiomatic: All drew fully on earlier canons to set examples for posterity, handed down from sages through successive dynasties, earning the name of golden statutes and jade provisions and erecting barriers against reckless speech that would break the law—preserving and enforcing them has been the practice for a very long time.

sentences.zh: 皇帝陛下，運齊七政，歷契千年，爰從創業開基，莫不積功累德。

translations.literal: Your Majesty the Emperor's fortune aligns with the seven regulators, your reign spans a thousand years; from founding the enterprise and laying the foundation, none have failed to accumulate merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's fortune aligns with the seven luminaries and your reign spans a thousand years; from the founding of the state, every step has accumulated merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 所宜直筆，具載鴻猷，若備錄前代之編年，目作聖朝之政統，此則是名不正也。

translations.literal: What is fitting is straightforward writing that fully records great designs; if one fully records the annals of former dynasties and titles it the administrative canon of the holy dynasty, this is where the name is not correct.
translations.idiomatic: What is fitting is straightforward writing that fully records your great designs; to compile the annals of former dynasties and title the work the holy dynasty's administrative canon would be a case of an improper name.

sentences.zh: 夫名不正則言不順，而媚時掠美，非其實矣。

translations.literal: When the name is not correct, words are not in accord; to flatter the times and seize credit for beauty is not the reality.
translations.idiomatic: When the name is improper, words do not accord with reality; to flatter the present age and claim undeserved credit would not reflect the truth.

sentences.zh: 若翦截其辭，此則是文不備也。

translations.literal: If one cuts and trims their wording, this is where the text is not complete.
translations.idiomatic: If their wording were cut and trimmed, the text would be incomplete.

sentences.zh: 夫文不備則啟爭端，而禮樂刑政，於斯亂矣。

translations.literal: When the text is not complete, disputes are opened; rites, music, punishments, and administration would then fall into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: An incomplete text invites dispute, and rites, music, punishments, and administration would fall into disorder.

sentences.zh: 若改舊條而為新制，則未審何門可以刊削，何事可以編聯。

translations.literal: If old provisions are changed into new institutions, it is not clear which sections may be excised and which matters may be linked together.
translations.idiomatic: If old provisions were changed into new institutions, it is unclear which sections could be cut and which matters could be linked together.

sentences.zh: 既當革故從新，又須廢彼行此，則未知國朝能守不能守乎？

translations.literal: Since one must reform the old and follow the new, and must abolish that and implement this, it is not known whether the dynastic court can preserve them or cannot preserve them?
translations.idiomatic: Since one must reform the old and follow the new, and abolish the former to implement the latter, it is unknown whether the court could maintain consistency or not?

sentences.zh: 臣等同共參詳，未見其可。

translations.literal: Your subjects together deliberated in detail and did not see that it was feasible.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects deliberated together and did not see how it could be done.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，嘉之，其事遂寢。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor praised it, and the matter was then laid aside.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor commended it, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前晉昌軍節度使李周為靜難軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Li Zhou, former military commissioner of Jinchang, was made military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Li Zhou, former military commissioner of Jinchang, was appointed military commissioner of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 是日，封皇第十一妹安定郡主為延慶長公主，皇第十二妹廣平郡主為清平長公主。

translations.literal: On that day, the Emperor's eleventh younger sister, Princess of Anding Commandery, was enfeoffed as Princess of Yanqing; the twelfth younger sister, Princess of Guangping Commandery, was enfeoffed as Princess of Qingping.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the emperor's eleventh younger sister, Princess of Anding Commandery, was enfeoffed as Princess of Yanqing, and his twelfth younger sister, Princess of Guangping Commandery, as Princess of Qingping.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，改東京玉華殿為永福殿。

translations.literal: In the second month on xinmao, the Yuhua Hall of the Eastern Capital was renamed Yongfu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinmao, the Yuhua Hall in the Eastern Capital was renamed Yongfu Hall.

sentences.zh: 中書上言：「太原潛龍莊望建為慶長宮，使相鄉望改為龍飛鄉，都尉裏望改為神光裏。

translations.literal: The Secretariat submitted: "The Qianlong Estate of Taiyuan should have a ward established as Qingchang Palace; the Xiangwang of the envoy's district should be changed to Longfei Township; the Liwang of the commandant's district should be changed to Shenguang Lane."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: "The Qianlong Estate at Taiyuan should have a ward established as Qingchang Palace; the Xiangwang of the envoy's district should be renamed Longfei Township, and the Liwang of the commandant's district renamed Shenguang Lane."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宰臣馮道、左散騎常侍韋勛、禮部員外郎楊昭儉自契丹使回。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Chief Minister Feng Dao, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Wei Xun, and Outer Office Director of Rites Yang Zhaojian returned from their mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Chief Minister Feng Dao, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Wei Xun, and Outer Office Director of Rites Yang Zhaojian returned from their embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 帝慰勞備至，錫賫豐厚。

translations.literal: The Emperor comforted and encouraged them to the utmost and bestowed generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted them with the utmost care and bestowed lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以天和節宴群官於廣政殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On gengzi, on the Tianhe Festival the Emperor banqueted the officials in Guangzheng Hall; gifts were bestowed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the emperor held a Tianhe Festival banquet for the officials in Guangzheng Hall and distributed gifts in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，左僕射劉句、給事中盧重自契丹使回，頒賜器幣如馮道等。

translations.literal: On the first day guimao of the third month, Left Vice Director Liu Gou and Supervising Secretary Lu Chong returned from their mission to the Khitan; vessels and gifts were distributed as to Feng Dao and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month (guimao), Left Vice Director Liu Gou and Supervising Secretary Lu Chong returned from their Khitan embassy and received vessels and gifts of the same kind as Feng Dao and his party.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，回鶻可汗仁美遣使貢方物，中有玉狻猊，實奇貨也。

translations.literal: On yisi, Kaghan Renmei of the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products; among them was a jade suanni—a truly rare treasure.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Kaghan Renmei of the Uyghurs sent envoys with tribute, including a jade suanni—a truly rare treasure.

sentences.zh: 丙午，涇州節度使張萬進卒，贈太師。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhang Wanjin, military commissioner of Jingzhou, died; posthumously awarded Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Wanjin, military commissioner of Jingzhou, died and was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己未，皇子開封尹鄭王重貴、歸德軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠、忠武軍節度使杜重威，並加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Prince of Zheng Chonggui, Prince of Kaifeng and heir apparent, Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Guide and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, and Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhongwu, were all made Associates of the Secretariat with the same authority as the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Prince Chonggui of Zheng, heir apparent and Prince of Kaifeng, Liu Zhiyuan, military commissioner of Guide and commander of the palace guard horse and foot, and Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhongwu, were all appointed Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 天平軍節度使趙在禮封衛國公。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of Tianping, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili, military commissioner of Tianping, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣內臣趙處比以版詔征華山隱者前右拾遺鄭雲叟、玉笥山道士羅隱之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the inner attendant Zhao Chubi was sent with an edict on boards to summon the Huashan recluse, former Right Reminder Zheng Yunsou, and the Yujian Mountain Daoist Luo Yinshi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the inner attendant Zhao Chubi was dispatched with an edict on boards to summon the Huashan recluse, former Right Reminder Zheng Yunsou, and the Yujian Mountain Daoist Luo Yinshi.

sentences.zh: 靈州戍將王彥忠據懷遠城作叛，帝遣供奉官齊延祚乘驛而往，彥忠率眾出降，延祚矯制殺之。

translations.literal: Wang Yanzhong, garrison commander of Lingzhou, seized Huaiyuan City and rebelled; the Emperor sent Palace Attendant Qi Yanzuo traveling by post relay; Yanzhong led his troops out to surrender, and Yanzuo forged an order and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanzhong, garrison commander at Lingzhou, seized Huaiyuan City and rebelled; the emperor sent palace attendant Qi Yanzuo by express relay. Yanzhong led his men out to surrender, but Yanzuo forged an order and had him killed.

sentences.zh: 詔：「齊延祚辜我誓言，擅行屠戮。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Qi Yanzuo has betrayed my sworn word and on his own authority carried out slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Qi Yanzuo has violated my sworn pledge and on his own authority carried out a massacre.

sentences.zh: 彰殺降之罪，隳示信之文。

translations.literal: He has made manifest the crime of killing those who surrendered and destroyed the text of displaying trust.
translations.idiomatic: He has made manifest the crime of killing those who surrendered and has undermined our pledge of good faith.

sentences.zh: 宜除名決重杖一頓配流。

translations.literal: He should be stripped of name and office, sentenced to one heavy beating, and banished by assignment.
translations.idiomatic: He is to be stripped of rank and office, sentenced to one heavy beating, and exiled by assignment.

sentences.zh: 王彥忠贈官收葬。

translations.literal: Wang Yanzhong was posthumously granted an office and given burial.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanzhong was posthumously granted an office and given a proper burial.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封回鶻可汗仁美為奉化可汗。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Uyghur Kaghan Renmei was enfeoffed as Kaghan of Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Uyghur Kaghan Renmei was enfeoffed as Kaghan of Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為鎮國軍節度使，張彥澤為彰義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Huangfu Yu, Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was made military commissioner of Zhenguo; Zhang Yanze was made military commissioner of Zhangyi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Huangfu Yu, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed military commissioner of Zhenguo, and Zhang Yanze military commissioner of Zhangyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，以河中節度副使薛仁謙為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: On the first day renshen of the fourth month of summer, Xue Renqian, deputy military commissioner of Hezhong, was made Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month (renshen), Xue Renqian, deputy military commissioner of Hezhong, was appointed Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以汝州防禦使宋彥筠為同州節度使；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Song Yanyun, defense commissioner of Ruzhou, was made military commissioner of Tongzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Song Yanyun, defense commissioner of Ruzhou, was appointed military commissioner of Tongzhou;

sentences.zh: 以護聖左右軍都指揮使李懷忠為侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使，領壽州忠正軍節度使；

translations.literal: Li Huaizhong, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Armies Protecting the Sage, was made Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Cavalry and concurrently military commissioner of Zhongzheng at Shouzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaizhong, commander of the left and right armies protecting the sage, was appointed commander of the palace guard cavalry and concurrently military commissioner of Zhongzheng at Shouzhou;

sentences.zh: 以奉國左右廂都指揮使郭謹為侍衛親軍步軍都指揮使、夔州寧江軍節度使。

translations.literal: Guo Jin, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Wings Serving the State, was made Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers and military commissioner of Ningjiang at Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: and Guo Jin, commander of the left and right wings serving the state, was appointed commander of the palace guard foot soldiers and military commissioner of Ningjiang at Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔廢長春宮使額。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict abolished the commissioner title of Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict abolished the Changchun Palace commissioner title.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載原敕云：同州長春宮使額宜停，沿宮職務，委州司制置。）〉

translations.literal: (The Five Dynasties Essentials records the original edict: The Changchun Palace commissioner title at Tongzhou should cease; routine palace duties are to be entrusted to the prefectural office for arrangement.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The Five Dynasties Essentials records the original edict: "The Changchun Palace commissioner title at Tongzhou is to be discontinued; routine palace duties are to be arranged by the prefectural office.")〉

sentences.zh: 己卯，改明德殿為滋德殿，宮城南門同名故也。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Mingde Hall was renamed Zide Hall, because it shared a name with the south gate of the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Mingde Hall was renamed Zide Hall because it shared a name with the south gate of the palace city.

sentences.zh: 以華州節度使劉遂凝為右龍武統軍，以右龍武統軍張廷蘊為絳州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Sunning, military commissioner of Huazhou, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army; Zhang Tingyun, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made prefect of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sunning, military commissioner of Huazhou, was appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and Zhang Tingyun, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made prefect of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，征前右拾遺鄭雲叟為右諫議大夫，玉笥山道士羅隱之賜號希夷先生。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the former Right Reminder Zheng Yunsou was summoned as Right Remonstrance Grandee; the Yujian Mountain Daoist Luo Yinshi was granted the style Master Xiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, former Right Reminder Zheng Yunsou was summoned as Right Remonstrance Grandee, and the Yujian Mountain Daoist Luo Yinshi was granted the style Master Xiyi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔棁權判太常卿，以端明殿學士、戶部侍郎和凝為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Cui Zhuo, Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and Vice Minister of War, was made Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; He Ning, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Cui Zhuo, expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy and vice minister of war, was appointed acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall and vice minister of revenue, was made expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 樞密院學士、尚書倉部郎中司徒詡，樞密院學士、尚書工部郎中顏衎並落職守本官，樞密副使張從恩改宣徽使：初廢樞密院故也。

translations.literal: Situ Xu, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Bureau Director of the Granaries in the Ministry of Revenue, and Yan Kan, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Bureau Director of Works in the Ministry of Works, were both removed from office and retained their original posts; Deputy Commissioner Zhang Cong'en was changed to Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat: this was because the Bureau of Military Affairs was first abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Situ Xu and Yan Kan, academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were both removed from their concurrent posts and retained their original offices; Deputy Commissioner Zhang Cong'en was transferred to Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat—because the Bureau of Military Affairs had just been abolished.

sentences.zh: 先是，桑維翰免樞密之務，以劉處讓代之，奏議多不稱旨，及處讓丁母憂，遂以密院印付中書，故密院廢焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sang Weihan was relieved of military affairs duties and Liu Churang replaced him; memorials and deliberations often did not accord with the Emperor's intent; when Churang entered mourning for his mother, the seal of the secret bureau was handed to the Secretariat, and therefore the secret bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Sang Weihan had been relieved of military affairs duties and Liu Churang replaced him, but his memorials often failed to please the emperor; when Churang entered mourning for his mother, the bureau's seal was handed to the Secretariat, and the bureau was therefore abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以韓昭裔為兵部尚書致仕，馬裔孫為太子賓客致仕，房暠為右驍衛大將軍致仕，皆唐末帝之舊臣也。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Han Zhaoyi was made Retired Minister of War, Ma Yisun Retired Guest of the Heir Apparent, and Fang Hao Retired General of the Right Martial Tiger Guard—all former ministers of the last Tang emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Han Zhaoyi, Ma Yisun, and Fang Hao were granted retirement as minister of war, guest of the heir apparent, and general of the Right Martial Tiger Guard respectively—all former ministers of the last Tang emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，升永、嶽二州為團練使額，改湘川縣為全州，從馬希範之奏也。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Yong and Yue prefectures were promoted to regimental training commissioner titles; Xiangchuan County was changed to Quanzhou—following Ma Xifan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yong and Yue prefectures were promoted to regimental training commissioner status, and Xiangchuan County was renamed Quanzhou, following Ma Xifan's memorial.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin of the fifth month, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive audience; guards and regalia as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month (renyin), the emperor held audience in Chongyuan Hall, with guards and ceremonial regalia in full form.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左僕射劉句兼太子太保，封譙國公。

translations.literal: On guimao, Left Vice Director Liu Gou was made concurrent Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Left Vice Director Liu Gou was appointed concurrent Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，昭順軍節度使姚彥章卒。

translations.literal: On yisi, Yao Yanzhang, military commissioner of Zhaoshun, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yao Yanzhang, military commissioner of Zhaoshun, died.

sentences.zh: 升靈州方渠鎮為威州，隸於靈武。

translations.literal: Fangqu Town of Lingzhou was promoted to Weizhou, subordinate to Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: Fangqu Town in Lingzhou was promoted to Weizhou, subordinate to Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 改舊威州為清邊軍。

translations.literal: The former Weizhou was changed to Qingbian Army.
translations.idiomatic: The former Weizhou was renamed Qingbian Army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，湖南節度使馬希範加天策上將軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, Ma Xifan, military commissioner of Hunan, was given the additional title Supreme General of the Heavenly Strategies.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Ma Xifan, military commissioner of Hunan, was given the additional title Supreme General of the Heavenly Strategies.

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使安叔千為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: An Shuqian, former military commissioner of Binzhou, was made military commissioner of Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An Shuqian, former military commissioner of Binzhou, was appointed military commissioner of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，虞部郎中楊昭儉可本官知制誥。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Yang Zhaojian, Bureau Director of the Parks, was approved to retain his original office and serve as Drafter of Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yang Zhaojian, bureau director of the parks, was approved to retain his original office and serve as drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置靜海軍於溫州，從錢元瓘之請也。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Jinghai Army was established at Wenzhou, following Qian Yuanguan's request.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Jinghai Army was established at Wenzhou at Qian Yuanguan's request.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以侍御史盧價為戶部員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: On renzi, Lu Jia, Attending Censor, was made Outer Office Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Drafter of Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lu Jia, attending censor, was appointed outer office director of revenue and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書崔居儉卒。

translations.literal: Cui Jujian, Minister of Revenue, died.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jujian, minister of revenue, died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔止絕朝臣，不得外州府求覓表狀，奏薦交親。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict forbade court officials from seeking out memorial forms in outer prefectures and memorializing to recommend relatives by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, an edict forbade court officials from soliciting recommendation forms from outer prefectures to nominate relatives by marriage.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，升金州為節鎮，以懷德軍為使額。

translations.literal: On yimao, Jinzhou was promoted to a military commission, with the Huaide Army as its commissioner title.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jinzhou was promoted to military commissioner status under the title Huaide Army.

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使潘環為懷德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Pan Huan, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was made military commissioner of the Huaide Army.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was appointed military commissioner of the Huaide Army.

sentences.zh: 右諫議大夫致仕鄭雲叟賜號逍遙先生，仍給致仕官俸。

translations.literal: Zheng Yunsou, Retired Right Remonstrance Grandee, was granted the style Master Xiaoyao and still given retired official salary.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yunsou, retired Right Remonstrance Grandee, was granted the style Master Xiaoyao and continued to receive retired official salary.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以刑部尚書姚顗為戶部尚書，以兵部侍郎、權判太常卿事崔棁為尚書左丞，以工部侍郎任贊為兵部侍郎，以禮部尚書李懌為刑部尚書，以左丞盧詹為禮部尚書，以左散騎常侍韋勛為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yao Yi, Minister of Punishments, was made Minister of Revenue; Cui Zhuo, Vice Minister of War and Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Ren Zan, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of War; Li Yin, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Punishments; Lu Zhan, Left Vice Director, was made Minister of Rites; Wei Xun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yao Yi was transferred from minister of punishments to minister of revenue; Cui Zhuo from vice minister of war and acting minister of sacrifices to left vice director of the Secretariat; Ren Zan from vice minister of works to vice minister of war; Li Yin from minister of rites to minister of punishments; Lu Zhan from left vice director to minister of rites; and Wei Xun from left regular attendant of the cavalry to vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廢華清宮為靈泉觀。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Huaqing Palace was abolished and made Lingquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Huaqing Palace was abolished and converted to Lingquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史臺奏：「省郎知雜之時，赴臺禮上，軍巡邸吏之輩，咸集公參，赤縣府司，悉呈杖印。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Censorate submitted: "When a provincial bureau director served as acting chief, on attending the Censorate for ceremonial reception, military patrol station clerks and the like all gathered for public audience; metropolitan county prefectural officials all presented staffs and seals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Censorate memorialized: "When a provincial bureau director served as acting chief, on attending the Censorate for ceremonial reception, military patrol station clerks and the like all gathered for public audience, and metropolitan county prefectural officials all presented staffs and seals.

sentences.zh: 今後年深御史判雜上事，欲依前例。

translations.literal: Henceforth, when a senior censor acts as chief on affairs, we wish to follow the former precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, when a senior censor acts as chief on affairs, we wish to follow the former precedent."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以鎮海軍衙內統軍、上直馬步軍都監、檢校太傅、睦州刺史陸仁章為同平章事，遙領遂州武信軍節度使；

translations.literal: On bingyin, Lu Renzhang, Commander-in-Chief within the Zhenhai Army headquarters, Director of the Upper Direct Horse and Foot Armies, Acting Grand Mentor, and prefect of Muzhou, was made Associate of the Secretariat and remotely held the military commission of Wuxin at Suizhou;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Lu Renzhang, commander within the Zhenhai Army headquarters, director of the upper direct horse and foot armies, acting grand mentor, and prefect of Muzhou, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and remotely held the military commission of Wuxin at Suizhou;

sentences.zh: 以鎮海軍興武左右開道都指揮使、明州刺史仰仁銓為檢校太傅、同平章事，領宣州寧國軍節度使，從錢元瓘之請也。

translations.literal: Yang Renquan, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Armies Opening the Way for Xingwu of the Zhenhai Army and prefect of Mingzhou, was made Acting Grand Mentor and Associate of the Secretariat, holding the military commission of Ningguo at Xuanzhou—following Qian Yuanguan's request.
translations.idiomatic: and Yang Renquan, commander of the left and right armies opening the way for Xingwu of the Zhenhai Army and prefect of Mingzhou, was appointed acting grand mentor and associate of the Secretariat, holding the military commission of Ningguo at Xuanzhou, at Qian Yuanguan's request.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未朔，陳郡民王武穿地得黃金數餅，州牧取而貢之。

translations.literal: On the first day xinwei of the sixth month, Wang Wu of Chen Commandery, digging in the ground, obtained several ingots of gold; the prefect took them and presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month (xinwei), Wang Wu of Chen Commandery unearthed several ingots of gold while digging; the prefect took them and presented them as tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「宿藏之物，既非符寶，不合入官。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Objects long hidden in the earth, since they are not talismans and treasures, should not enter the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Objects long buried in the earth are not imperial talismans or treasures and should not enter the public treasury.

sentences.zh: 」命付所獲之家。

translations.literal: He ordered them given to the household that found them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered them returned to the household that found them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，西京大風雨，應天福門屋瓦皆飛，鴟吻俱折。

translations.literal: On gengchen, in the Western Capital a great wind and rain blew; at the Yingtianfu Gate all roof tiles flew off and all ridge ornaments were broken.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, a great storm struck the Western Capital; at Yingtianfu Gate every roof tile was torn away and every ridge ornament broken.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔禮部貢舉宜權停一年。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict stated that the Ministry of Rites civil service examinations should be provisionally suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict suspended the Ministry of Rites civil service examinations for one year.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengzi of the seventh month of autumn, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month (gengzi), there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 西京大水，伊、洛、、澗盡溢，壞天津橋。

translations.literal: In the Western Capital great floods; the Yi, Luo, and Jian all overflowed, destroying the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital suffered severe flooding; the Yi, Luo, and Jian rivers all overflowed and destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以華清宮使李頃為右領軍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On guimao, Li Qing, Commissioner of Huaqing Palace, was made General of the Upper Army of the Right Leading Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Qing, commissioner of Huaqing Palace, was appointed general of the upper army of the Right Leading Army.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以定州節度使皇甫遇為潞州節度使、檢校太尉，以潞州節度使侯益為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was made military commissioner of Luzhou and Acting Grand Preceptor; Hou Yi, military commissioner of Luzhou, was made military commissioner of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Huangfu Yu, military commissioner of Dingzhou, was transferred to Luzhou as acting grand preceptor, and Hou Yi, military commissioner of Luzhou, was transferred to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，御史中丞薛融等上詳定編敕三百六十八道，分為三十一卷。

translations.literal: On wushen, Vice Censor-in-Chief Xue Rong and others submitted the fully revised compiled statutes, three hundred sixty-eight items in thirty-one fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Vice Censor-in-Chief Xue Rong and others submitted the fully revised compiled statutes—368 provisions in 31 fascicles.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「先令天下州郡公私鑄錢，近多鉛錫相兼，缺薄小弱，有違條制。

translations.literal: On that day, an edict stated: "Formerly an order was issued that prefectures and districts throughout the realm, public and private, might cast coin; recently much lead and tin have been mixed in, making pieces thin, small, and weak, in violation of the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: That same day an edict declared: "An earlier order allowed public and private coin casting throughout the realm, but recently much lead and tin has been mixed in, producing thin, small, weak pieces that violate the regulations.

sentences.zh: 今後私鑄錢下禁依舊法。

translations.literal: Henceforth private coin casting is forbidden in accordance with the old law."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth private coin casting is forbidden under the old law."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，以太子少師梁文矩為太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: On renxu, Liang Wenju, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was made Retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Liang Wenju, junior preceptor of the heir apparent, was granted retirement as grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 閏七月庚午朔，百官不入閣，雨沾服故也。

translations.literal: On the first day gengwu of the intercalary seventh month, the hundred officials did not enter the Hall of Administration, because rain had soaked their robes.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary seventh month (gengwu), the hundred officials did not enter the Hall of Administration because rain had soaked their court robes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以中書侍郎平章事、集賢殿大學士桑維翰為檢校司空、兼侍中、相州彰德軍節度使，以彰德軍節度使王庭允為義武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Sang Weihan, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Associate of the Secretariat, and Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall, was made Acting Minister of Works and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, military commissioner of Zhangde at Xiangzhou; Wang Tingyun, military commissioner of Zhangde, was made military commissioner of Yiwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Sang Weihan, vice director of the Secretariat, associate of the Secretariat, and grand academician of the Jixian Hall, was appointed acting minister of works and concurrent vice director of the Secretariat, with the military commission of Zhangde at Xiangzhou; Wang Tingyun, military commissioner of Zhangde, was transferred to Yiwu.

sentences.zh: 尚書戶部奏：「李自倫義居七世，準敕旌表門閭。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue memorialized: "Li Zilun dwells in righteousness through seven generations; according to the edict his gate and lane are to be marked with commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue memorialized: "Li Zilun has maintained a household of righteousness for seven generations; per the edict his gate and lane are to be marked with commendation.

sentences.zh: 先有鄧州義門王仲昭六代同居，其旌表有廳事步欄，前列屏樹烏頭。

translations.literal: Formerly Wang Zhongzhao of Dengzhou, a righteous household with six generations dwelling together, had his commendation with a hall, steps, railings, and in front a screen of trees with black-headed gateposts.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Wang Zhongzhao of Dengzhou, a six-generation communal household, had been commended with a hall, steps, railings, and in front a screen of trees with black-headed gateposts.

sentences.zh: 正門閥閱一丈二尺，二柱相去一丈，柱端安瓦桷墨染，號為烏頭。

translations.literal: The main gate bore a commemorative tablet one zhang two chi high; the two pillars stood one zhang apart, with tile eaves at the pillar tops painted black—called black-headed.
translations.idiomatic: The main gate bore a commemorative tablet one zhang two chi high; two pillars stood one zhang apart, with tile eaves at the tops painted black—called "black-headed."

sentences.zh: 築雙闕一丈，在烏頭之南三丈七尺。

translations.literal: A paired gate-tower one zhang high was built three zhang seven chi south of the black-headed gate.
translations.idiomatic: A paired gate-tower one zhang high was built three zhang seven chi south of the black-headed gate.

sentences.zh: 夾街十有五步，槐柳成列。

translations.literal: Fifteen paces on either side of the street, locust and willow trees were planted in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Locust and willow trees were planted in rows fifteen paces along either side of the street.

sentences.zh: 今舉此為例，則令式不該。

translations.literal: If this is taken as precedent, the regulations do not cover it."
translations.idiomatic: If this is taken as precedent, the regulations do not cover it."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「王仲昭正廳烏頭門等制，不載令文，又無敕命，既非故事，難黷大倫，宜從令式，只表門閭。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Wang Zhongzhao's main hall, black-headed gate, and the like are not recorded in the statutes, nor is there an edictal command; since they are not precedent, they would profane great propriety—follow the regulations and mark only the gate and lane.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Wang Zhongzhao's main hall, black-headed gate, and similar features are not recorded in the statutes and lack an edictal command; since they are not precedent, they would profane great propriety—follow the regulations and mark only the gate and lane.

sentences.zh: 於李自倫所居之前，量地之宜，高其外門，門外安綽楔。

translations.literal: Before Li Zilun's dwelling, measure the ground appropriately and raise the outer gate; outside the gate install a commemorative frame.
translations.idiomatic: Before Li Zilun's dwelling, the ground should be measured appropriately to raise the outer gate, with a commemorative frame installed outside it.

sentences.zh: 門外左右各建一臺，高一丈二尺，廣狹方正，稱臺之形，圬以白泥，四隅漆赤。

translations.literal: On the left and right outside the gate, build one platform each, one zhang two chi high, square in breadth and height fitting the platform form, plastered with white clay, the four corners painted red.
translations.idiomatic: On the left and right outside the gate, build one platform each, one zhang two chi high, square in proportion, plastered with white clay with the four corners painted red.

sentences.zh: 其行列樹植，隨其事力。

translations.literal: The rows of planted trees follow the household's means.
translations.idiomatic: Rows of planted trees should follow the household's means.

sentences.zh: 其同籍課役，一準令文。

translations.literal: Corvée and tax obligations of the same register follow the statutes entirely."
translations.idiomatic: Corvée and tax obligations of the same register follow the statutes entirely."

sentences.zh: 」壬午，濮州刺史武從諫勒歸私第，受贓十五萬故也。

translations.literal: On renwu, Wu Congjian, prefect of Pu, was compelled to return to his private residence for having accepted bribes of one hundred fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wu Congjian, prefect of Pu, was compelled to return to private life for accepting bribes of 150,000 cash.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，故皇子河南尹重乂妻虢國夫人李氏落發為尼，賜名悟因，仍錫紫衣、法號及夏臘二十。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Lady Li, wife of the late Prince Chongyi, Prince of Henan, Princess of Guo, took the tonsure as a nun; she was granted the name Wuyin and still given purple robes, a dharma name, and twenty summer years of ordination.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Lady Li, wife of the late Prince Chongyi of Henan and Princess of Guo, took the tonsure as a nun; she was granted the name Wuyin along with purple robes, a dharma name, and twenty summer years of ordination.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，河決博平，甘陵大水。

translations.literal: On the first day jihai of the eighth month, the Yellow River broke its banks at Boping; Ganling suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month (jihai), the Yellow River broke its banks at Boping, and Ganling suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以守司空兼門下侍郎、平章事、宏文館大學士馮道為守司徒、兼侍中，封魯國公。

translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Bozhou was promoted to defense commissioner status, remaining subordinate to Songzhou as before.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，司天監馬重績等進所撰新歷。

translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Ma Chongji of the Directorate of Astronomy and others presented the new calendar they had compiled.

sentences.zh: 降詔褒之，詔翰林學士承旨和凝制序，命之曰《調元曆》。

translations.literal: An edict commended them; the Hanlin academician expositor-in-chief He Ning was ordered to compose a preface, and it was titled the Calendar for Harmonizing the Origin.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended them; Hanlin expositor-in-chief He Ning was ordered to compose a preface, and the work was titled the Calendar for Harmonizing the Origin.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以右羽林統軍周密為鄜州節度使。

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhou Mi, commander of the Right Forest Feathered Army, was appointed military commissioner of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，升婺州為武勝軍額。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Wuzhou was promoted to the Wusheng Army commissioner title.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wuzhou was promoted to the Wusheng Army commissioner title.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宴群臣於永福殿。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor banqueted the officials in Yongfu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the emperor banqueted the officials in Yongfu Hall.

translations.idiomatic: The Zhide Palace in the Western Capital was made his temple; sacrificial animals, vessels, and robes were all supplied by the government.

translations.idiomatic: Tang received the phoenix mandate and opened the fiefs of Zhe and Jie.

translations.idiomatic: Cherishing the former dynasty and examining old canons, it is fitting to enfeoff territory and enable them to maintain the ancestral temple.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Jian, king of Goryeo, sent envoys presenting local products.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Li Song, vice director of the Secretariat and associate of the Secretariat, was appointed acting director of the Jixian Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔停寒食、七夕、重陽及十月暖帳內外群官貢獻。

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict suspended Cold Food, Qixi, Double Ninth, and tenth-month warm-pavilion tribute offerings by internal and external officials.

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Luo Zhouyue, deputy military commissioner of Wusheng, was appointed supervising secretary; Li Xiang, secretariat drafter, was transferred to vice minister of rites; Lü Qi from rites to punishments; Wang Song from punishments to revenue; Yan Zhi from revenue to war; and Wang Yijian, secretariat drafter, was made compiler of the Historiography Office and acting director.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Cheng Xun, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, perished at sea; the court suspended audiences for one day and posthumously granted him right vice director.
